roles.title: Head of Product - Interfaces
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Set the product direction for Interfaces. Connect Dashboard, Mobile, Command, and API/MCP through a clear view of customer needs and the role of each surface
Lead and develop the PM team. Build clear ownership, coach product judgment, hire strong people, and help the team deliver excellent work
Shape Mercury’s AI experience. Partner with the Command team to turn new AI capabilities into useful products that help customers complete financial work
Improve the core product experience. Make it easier for customers to understand their finances, find the right action, and move between devices and workflows
Build shared capabilities. Help Mercury teams deliver through common foundations such as navigation, tasks, notifications, and agent interactions

roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Invoicing
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Own the roadmap for Mercury Invoicing across every surface: the dashboard, the builder and the payer experience
Talk to customers and prospects, and turn what you hear into clear next steps
Take on a full backlog of work we already know customers need: accounting integrations, invoice templates, credits and credit memos, promos and coupons .. the list goes on
Keep the product simple while making it more powerful, so it grows with customers as their businesses scale
Find where AI can make getting paid meaningfully better, without chasing hype

roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Users
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Own the experience of collaboration on Mercury - when a founder adds an employee, finance team, or accountant, we need to consider the roles, permissions, and product experiences…
Make it easier for a founder to bring their whole team onto Mercury: find out why they hesitate, and make invitation obvious, easy, and high-trust
Take it everywhere: build for the experience across email, slack, iMessage and wherever people are interacting about finance
Build for scale: work with our largest customers to understand how they manage employee spend and financial operations as they grow, delivering critical functionality that empowers
Shape where this space goes as our product ambition grows and the kinds of users we support change, agents among them

roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Consumer Credit Card
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Build a card people put at the front of the wallet and recommend without being asked
Take the card from zero to launch: decide what ships first, and carry it through program setup and compliance sign-off
Make the approval the clearest and fastest in the category: underwriting owns the model, you own the application, the wait, and the answer
Own how customers experience their line: an increase that feels earned, a decrease that is explained
Own the proposition we take to customers, from rewards and redemption to pricing, and understand the economics that fund it

roles.title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the…
Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and…

roles.title: Head of Product - Business Banking
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Own the P&L, strategy, and product offering: accounts, user experience, payments, new rails, and agents
Build AI - and data-driven user experiences at scale better than the alternatives
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set an operating cadence and culture that drives…
Deepen the core account and take new products 0-1 to scale: optimize what businesses run on, and invest in new rails, capabilities, and agents so customers can focus on building…
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them

roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Reconciliation
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Mercury’s reconciliation platform, including the critical work required to support Mercury’s bank charter
Partner deeply with engineers to understand how financial data moves through Mercury’s systems, including schemas, transformations, dependencies, and failure modes
Work closely with other Product teams, Accounting, Finance, and Reconciliation Operations to define priorities and deliverables
Evolve Mercury’s reconciliation platform to handle long term scale, simplifying integration and enabling teams across the company to benefit from unified reconciliation systems…
Build tools that help internal teams identify discrepancies, understand their causes, resolve them quickly, and report accurately

roles.title: Head of Product - Business Lending
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Own the business lending P&L and strategy: Set the multi-year strategy - which products to build, which segments to serve, how to grow originations against economic and credit…
Build and scale the lending org: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing PM team,strong product build discipline, develop future leaders, and establish the operating cadence…
Take products from 0-1 to scale: Launch and grow Mercury’s lending products - term loans, lines of credit, and what comes next, and build the experimentation loop that compounds…
Partner with credit, underwriting, and risk on credit policy, underwriting models, and eligibility.
Manage capital and lending partners: Work with finance, capital markets, and banking/lending partners to keep the business well-capitalized and structured to scale, and own those…

roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Business Lending
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Mercury’s business lending product suite
Drive the end-to-end customer journey — eligibility and discovery, application, underwriting and decisioning, funding, servicing, and repayment
Partner with risk and data science to design underwriting and decisioning experiences that balance speed and approval rates with sound credit and compliance controls
Work with design and engineering to make the application feel effortless, transparent, and trustworthy for business owners
Collaborate with banking partners, legal, and compliance to ensure the product is regulatory-compliant and operationally sound

roles.title: Open Call for Founders / Founding Teams - Product Management and Engineering
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

bullets: Find the problem. Work close enough to customers that you spot what matters before anyone assigns it to you — then decide it’s worth building.
Build and automate the workflow end to end using Command, CLI, MCP, and the rest of our AI stack.
Ship to customers fast — quick understanding, tight iteration, deploy.
Measure the impact honestly, then do the next one. Kill what didn’t move; double down on what did.
Run as an autonomous team — pick the target, ship the thing, own the outcome.
